name: Boomerang
summary:
Boomerang is a multiplayer experience for leadership and team development workshops that places team members in a post-apocalyptic environment where they must work together to save the world. The experience offers an engaging way to look at teamwork, ethics and risk-taking decisions, social inclusion, and individual and group task contributions.

Boomerang is a licensed virtual reality leadership development experience and requires an account and prior authorization from Jenson8 in order to access.
